items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: That band was as good as Lunceford's or any of those bands, really.

ctx.x: It was about money. The leaders used to have a great habit in those days of having a crowded house and telling you the man ran off with the money, you know. Well, you had no way of knowing whether he's telling the truth or not. You don't even know who the man is to start off with! So that kind of made it kind of deep, you know.

So then I went with Speed Webb. That was a good band. A very good band. I just wish that band could have got to New York, to ...(?)...(?)... I think that band would have still been going today. That band was as good as Lunceford's or any of those bands, really.
Yeah, everybody I've talked to who was in that band, Vic and Teddy, they all say the same thing -- it was a great band.
